fields.name: memory_limit
fields.label: Memory limit
fields.help: Optional. The most memory this app's own container may use. Left empty it gets 1g, which is what this app has been measured to need — set it lower and the app may not start, and it will fail as a 502 with nothing about memory to explain it. Any database this app brings has its own separate ceiling.

fields.name: cpu_limit
fields.label: CPU limit
fields.help: Optional. How many CPU cores this app's own container may use — 1 for one full core, 0.5 for half. This server has 4, and Docker will not start a container asking for more. Left empty there is no CPU limit at all. Going past this does not kill anything; the container waits, so the symptom is slowness rather than an error. Any database this app brings is not limited by it.

starter_files./mautic-init/start.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Managed by the panel's Mautic recipe (RC-37). The web container runs this
# before the image's own /entrypoint.sh. Delete it to get the image's
# behaviour back (Mautic's web installer at the site address).
set -e

# HTTPS behind the panel's proxy: PHP sees HTTPS=on for requests the proxy
# received over HTTPS, so Symfony builds https links and secure cookies.
echo 'SetEnvIf X-Forwarded-Proto https HTTPS=on' > /etc/apache2/conf-enabled/zz-forwarded-https.conf

config=/var/www/html/config/local.php
installed() {
    [ -f "$config" ] && php -d display_errors=0 -r 'include getenv("MAUTIC_LOCAL_PHP"); exit(!empty($parameters["db_driver"]) && !empty($parameters["site_url"]) ? 0 : 1);'
}
export MAUTIC_LOCAL_PHP="$config"

if ! installed; then
    # The same preparation as the image's own startup checks, done first so the
    # install runs before Apache can serve the web installer to anyone.
    for dir in /var/www/html/config /var/www/html/var/logs /var/www/html/docroot/media/files /var/www/html/docroot/media/images; do
        mkdir -p "$dir"
        chown www-data:www-data "$dir"
    done
    [ -f "$config" ] || cp -p /templates/local.php "$config"
    chown www-data:www-data "$config"
    echo "[mautic-init] installing Mautic for ${MAUTIC_URL}"
    su -s /bin/bash www-data -c 'php /mautic-init/install.php'
    echo "[mautic-init] installation finished"
else
    # Keep site_url in step with the panel's address after a domain change.
    su -s /bin/bash www-data -c 'php /mautic-init/sync-url.php' || true
fi

# Mautic compiles cookie_secure (true when site_url is https) into its Symfony
# cache, and the image ships a cache built without a site_url, so the session
# cookie was not Secure (RC-37 smoke). Rebuild the cache once per container
# and address: the marker lives in the container's own filesystem, so a
# recreated container (new image, new domain) rebuilds it and a plain restart
# does not. It takes about a minute.
marker=/var/www/html/var/cache/.panel-site-url
if [ "$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null)" != "$MAUTIC_URL" ]; then
    echo "[mautic-init] rebuilding the cache for ${MAUTIC_URL}"
    if su -s /bin/bash www-data -c 'php /var/www/html/bin/console cache:clear --no-interaction'; then
        printf '%s' "$MAUTIC_URL" > "$marker"
    fi
fi

exec /entrypoint.sh
starter_files./mautic-init/install.php:
<?php

// Managed by the panel's Mautic recipe (RC-37). Run once by start.sh, as
// www-data, while Mautic is not installed. It runs Mautic's own installer
// (bin/console mautic:install) with the admin account from the container's
// environment. The values are read here instead of being passed on a command
// line, so the password never shows in the server's process list.
// The database settings come from config/local.php (the image's template reads
// MAUTIC_DB_*).

$_SERVER['argv'] = $argv = [
    '/var/www/html/bin/console',
    'mautic:install',
    '--no-interaction',
    '--force',
    '--admin_username=admin',
    '--admin_email='.getenv('MAUTIC_ADMIN_EMAIL'),
    '--admin_password='.getenv('MAUTIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD'),
    (string) getenv('MAUTIC_URL'),
];
$_SERVER['argc'] = $argc = count($argv);

chdir('/var/www/html');
require '/var/www/html/bin/console';
starter_files./mautic-init/sync-url.php:
<?php

// Managed by the panel's Mautic recipe (RC-37). Run by start.sh, as www-data,
// on every start of an installed Mautic. Mautic keeps its address as site_url
// in config/local.php; the panel passes the site's current address as
// MAUTIC_URL, so after a domain change this writes the new address there.
// Nothing happens when they already match.

$file = (string) getenv('MAUTIC_LOCAL_PHP');
$url = (string) getenv('MAUTIC_URL');
if ($file === '' || ! preg_match('#^https://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+/?$#', $url)) {
    exit(0);
}

$parameters = [];
include $file;
if (empty($parameters['site_url']) || $parameters['site_url'] === $url) {
    exit(0);
}

$parameters['site_url'] = $url;
file_put_contents($file, "<?php\n\$parameters = ".var_export($parameters, true).";\n", LOCK_EX);
echo "[mautic-init] site_url set to {$url}\n";
